name: PowerShell Logging Disabled Via Registry Key Tampering
description: Detects changes to the registry for the currently logged-in user. In order to disable PowerShell module logging, script block logging or transcription and script execution logging
author: GAI_CTI
query: (registry.path:(*\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PowerShell\\* OR *\\Microsoft\\PowerShellCore\\*)) AND (registry.path:(*\\ModuleLogging\\EnableModuleLogging OR *\\ScriptBlockLogging\\EnableScriptBlockLogging OR *\\ScriptBlockLogging\\EnableScriptBlockInvocationLogging OR *\\Transcription\\EnableTranscripting OR *\\Transcription\\EnableInvocationHeader OR *\\EnableScripts)) AND winlog.event_data.Details:DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)
